item.title: HS BASKETBALL: Jones, defense leads Montrose to upset of No. 8 Mountain View
item.description: Sadie Jones scored 10 of her 12 points in the second half to lead Montrose to an upset win over No. 8 Mountain View, 36-35, on Friday night in a Lackawanna League Division III girls basketball game. Montrose improved to 13-7 overall and is tied with Mountain View at 11-1 in the league with two games remaining. Carley Frey added seven points, and Myckenna Kublo had six for the Lady Meteors. item.title: AHL: Dumba’s hat trick leads Penguins over Lehigh Valley
item.description: A fast start and strong finish helped propel the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins to another victory over Turnpike rival Lehigh Valley on Friday night at the PPL Center in Allentown. Matt Dumba recorded a hat-trick, scoring one goal in each period in a 6-5 victory over the Phantoms. The Penguins are 6-0-0-1 against Lehigh Valley this season and 31-12-2-2 overall. item.title: Minisink Lions Club’s biannual cleanup
item.description: North Pocono Minisink Lions Club members recently completed their second biannual cleanup of a 2-mile stretch of Route 690 in Moscow. The club is a 30-plus-year member of PennDOT’s Adopt-A-Highway program. The Lions thank those drivers who slow down when they see members with safety vests during the litter pickup event. From left: Dave Ogonosky, Matt Alferio, Glenn Czulada, Frank Bonacci and Jim Strempek.

item.title: HS FOOTBALL: 2025 All-Region Team Picks Super Bowl LX
item.description: The tradition continues: Well, for now anyway. Today is the day The Times-Tribune All-Region Football Team takes over Grid Picks. item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Fenton leads Scranton Prep past Abington Heights
item.description: SOUTH ABINGTON TWP. — Within a seven-day span, the Scranton Prep girls basketball team had to play the other four contenders in Lackawanna Division I. After winning the first three of those games, Ava Fenton made sure the Classics completed a perfect run through that gauntlet.
